data_dependencies: Massive causal equities aggregates, NBBO, reference, news, and market context
Robinhood current account, tradability, executable quote, Level 2, review, order, fill, position, and protection state
point-in-time filing, security-status, financing, dilution, halt, and corporate-action evidence when applicable
versioned local risk session, authorization, campaign, and operator-control state
causal_inputs.decision_time_rule: Use only information available at or before the exact decision timestamp; preserve source and decision watermarks.
causal_inputs.completed_bar_rule: Completed-bar features end at T-1; current quotes and partial-bar observations must be labeled separately.
causal_inputs.missing_data_rule: Execution-critical missing or contradictory data blocks entry; contextual missing data remains UNKNOWN and is not silently zero.

setup_rules: opening-range acceptance, VWAP reclaim and hold, first controlled pullback, tight-base release, or materially new base/retest
completed holding, higher-support, or clean-retest bar plus two independent positive price, volume, same-time RVOL, or sector observations
avoid first vertical discovery candle, late parabolic extension, failed progress, and repeated rejection
entry_or_research_rules: LIVE identity and contract hash, durable emergency stop clear, exact causal trigger, fresh Massive NBBO, fresh Robinhood quote and Level 2, final preview, and canonical entry risk authorization are mandatory
use limit entry inside the reviewed chase ceiling and dynamically size from stop/stress risk, depth, slippage, unleveraged buying power, equity, correlation, and monitorability
adds are optional and allowed only in a profitable strengthened thesis with completed new structure
exit_or_outcome_rules: exit on catastrophe stop, hard structural invalidation, failed protection, adverse security evidence, or mandatory closeout
otherwise require confirmed failure or at least two independent exhaustion signals for a discretionary full exit
trail orderly core beneath confirmed five-minute structure and a parabolic runner beneath confirmed one-minute structure without widening the original stop
invalidations: failed VWAP, support, opening-range, or structural acceptance without prompt reclaim
stale, crossed, contradictory, or non-executable quotes; spread, depth, or slippage failure
unresolved halt, adverse filing/security-status evidence, exhaustion lock, or contradicted thesis
operator emergency stop, broker acknowledgment uncertainty, buying-power mismatch, loss lock, or unavailable protection workflow

notes: Only LIVE records under this contract may reach broker review.
PAPER and SHADOW records remain zero-authority even when generated by this Pilot.

lane_risk_translation.notional_rule: reviewed_entry_price * quantity * contract_multiplier, capped by actual unleveraged buying power and projected gross exposure no greater than current equity
lane_risk_translation.stop_defined_risk_rule: loss from worst reviewed executable entry to exact structural stop including modeled spread and stop slippage
lane_risk_translation.stress_loss_rule: proposed new risk is the greater of stop-defined execution loss or conservative correlated, option, gap, and halt stress loss, plus an execution reserve without double counting
lane_adjustments: premarket requires stricter spread, displayed depth, escape-liquidity, monitoring, and 9:30 protection handling
under-$5 requires stricter spread, depth, dollar volume, security-status, financing, and halt-resumption handling
single-leg long options require exact chain, contract quote, depth, debit, multiplier, tail-loss, and maximum-contractual-loss treatment
all lanes share the irreversible -$100 account-day loss lock and central dynamic 0%-100% unleveraged notional authority

cost_execution_model.quote_source: Fresh Robinhood executable quote and Level 2 are broker authority; Massive NBBO is a required independent data check.
cost_execution_model.spread_model: Use the contemporaneous executable bid/ask spread and enforce both the lane absolute rule and spread no greater than 15% of entry-to-stop distance.
cost_execution_model.slippage_model: Model entry, stop, gap, halt, and closeout slippage explicitly in risk facts; reject when maximum acceptable slippage is exceeded.
cost_execution_model.fee_model: Use broker-confirmed fees when available and never silently assume unavailable fees are zero in performance reporting.
cost_execution_model.fill_model: Limit orders only for entry; only Robinhood-confirmed fills count in LIVE, with a 10-second acknowledgment deadline and duplicate-submission ban.
cost_execution_model.maximum_contractual_loss_rule: For long options, record full debit plus applicable fees as maximum contractual loss; for equity record null and retain modeled stress/tail loss.

session_calendar_rules.calendar: Current U.S. equity market calendar verified before market-data or broker activity
session_calendar_rules.research_or_entry_window: Live phase 07:00-16:00 ET; premarket equity entry 07:05-09:20, regular equity entry 09:35-15:30, option entry 09:45-15:30
session_calendar_rules.mandatory_flat_rule: Cancel remaining entries and close all positions through reconciled safe exits by 15:55 ET; no overnight exposure.
session_calendar_rules.holiday_rule: On a verified market holiday, exit without market, scanner, web, or broker calls.

entry_or_research_kill_conditions: durable emergency-entry stop engaged or unreadable
Robinhood authentication, account, order, position, buying-power, review, or protection state unreadable or contradictory
irreversible -$100 loss lock, post-objective floor failure, or exhausted dynamic risk capacity
BROKER_ACK_UNKNOWN or unresolved possible duplicate submission
BUYING_POWER_MISMATCH above max($5, 1% of current broker-confirmed equity)
stale or contradictory execution data, failed liquidity, unresolved halt, or adverse security-status evidence
suspension_criteria.operator_stop_semantics: Engagement blocks ENTRY, ADD, and reentry but never blocks protection, exit, cancellation, closeout, reconciliation, grading, or reporting; release is PROTECTED_USER_ONLY.

known_failure_modes: momentum score can identify volatility without identifying direction
late vertical extension can erase remaining opportunity
spread and stop slippage can overwhelm modeled edge
correlated positions can understate aggregate downside
halts and gaps can exceed stop-defined loss
broker or market-data disagreement can make a candidate non-executable
